failures.generatedSql:
WITH 
-- 2017年上半年首单用户
first_half_2017_users AS (
    SELECT customer_id
    FROM orders
    WHERE 
        order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND 
        order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01' AND
        order_id IN (
            SELECT order_id
            FROM (
                SELECT 
                    customer_id, 
                    order_id,
                    ROW_NUMBER() OVER (PARTITION BY customer_id ORDER BY order_purchase_timestamp) as rn
                FROM orders
                WHERE order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-01-01' AND order_purchase_timestamp < '2017-07-01'
            ) t
            WHERE rn = 1
        )
),
-- 2017年下半年这些用户的下单情况
second_half_2017_orders AS (
    SELECT 
        o.customer_id,
        DATE_TRUNC('month', o.order_purchase_timestamp) as month
    FROM orders o
    JOIN first_half_2017_users f ON o.customer_id = f.customer_id
    WHERE o.order_purchase_timestamp >= '2017-07-01' AND o.order_purchase_timestamp < '2018-01-01'
),
-- 计算每月留存用户数
monthly_retention AS (
    SELECT 
        month,
        COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as retained_users
    FROM second_half_2017_orders
    GROUP BY month
),
-- 计算2017年上半年首单用户总数
total_first_half_users AS (
    SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT customer_id) as total_users
    FROM first_half_2017_users
)
-- 计算留存率
SELECT 
    EXTRACT(MONTH FROM month) as month,
    retained_users,
    total_users,
    ROUND(retained_users * 100.0 / total_users, 2) as retention_rate_percent
FROM monthly_retention
CROSS JOIN total_first_half_users
ORDER BY month
LIMIT 6;
